author: Jakeylooooove
quote: I don't understand the point of still hyping up an old game that was released in 1999 in 2026. Nintendo has not updated their consoles for over a decade. Their consoles have long been lagging behind The Times and often have games locked at 30 frames per second. However, despite this, many die-hard Nintendo fans still mindlessly give them a perfect score of 10. Nintendo has long run out of ideas. They can no longer produce more representative works. This is more like a toy for children rather than a universal product suitable for everyone. Moreover, even from the perspective of children, Nintendo's games are not as good as its previous works.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Jakeylooooove
quote: A perfect open-world game, with details so abundant they're almost exaggerated. You feel as if you truly live in this city, not merely a visitor. If you can calm down and take it in, I think you'll fall deeply in love with it.
